messages:
maria (Finance): Heads up — found a mismatch between GCP Marketplace statement (invoice 2026-02-GCP-789) and our reserved GPU commitments ledger for Feb. Statement shows $13,412 in reseller credits; our GL shows $9,975 applied. Need help reconciling before month close. @ajay @sam

sam (CloudOps): Can you paste the statement line? Could be exchange rate, marketplace fees, or a negative adjustment on the settlement.

maria (Finance): Pasting the relevant CSV lines from the vendor PDF export:
```
SKU,Description,Amount,Type,Invoice
redwood-dedicated-gpu-commit-1,Reserved GPU commitment,13412,MarketplaceCredit,2026-02-GCP-789
redwood-dedicated-gpu-burst,On-demand burst,1245,Charge,2026-02-GCP-789
```
Our internal ledger extract shows:
```
commit_id,applied_amount,period
commit-2026-02-01,9975,Feb-2026
```

ajay (Eng-Infra): I'll pull the GCP billing export (BigQuery) and map the marketplace SKU -> our commitment IDs. Sometimes marketplace credits get split across linked accounts and the mapping fails. @billing-bot can you attach the gcp_billing_export_2026_02 table?

billing-bot: Attached export link: bigquery://redwood-prod.billing.gcp_billing_export_2026_02 (read-only). Also note one adjustment row: ADJ-9876 for -$2,437 marked as "partner fee reversal".

sam (CloudOps): Also check AWS Marketplace for the same partner/reseller account. We had a similar timing mismatch in Jan where AWS posted credits after we closed the ledger. Could be cross-cloud timing or manual refunds.

elaine (Revenue Ops): Is this tied to the manual credit we recorded on 2026-02-12? I have a Stripe ledger entry for a manual credit of $3,200 to reseller account RSLR-452. If that was processed outside marketplace flows it won't show as an applied marketplace credit.

maria (Finance): Good call — Stripe shows that manual credit. Marketplace shows it as applied to the invoice line instead of being refunded, so two different bookkeeping treatments. That explains part of the delta: 13412 - 3200 = 10212 (still ~237 difference).

natalie (Customer Success): No open CS tickets about surprise credits but ACME-Prod had a question about a negative invoice line last week and marked it resolved. I'll reopen and confirm whether they saw anything odd.

ajay (Eng-Infra): I'm going to join the dots: 1) Pull BigQuery export and AGG by invoice/sku; 2) Crosswalk marketplace SKU -> our commit table (commit-2026-02-01); 3) Check for ADJ rows and partner fee reversals that might be netted. ETA EOD PT (6pm).

sam (CloudOps): If you hit mismapped linked accounts, ping eng-infra infra-billing alias — we've seen linked-project splits cause ~10-20% misapplied credits. Also check region tags: GCP CAMS sometimes tags credits to eur-west1 which we allocate differently.

maria (Finance): :thumbsup: please add any suggested journal entries so Revenue Ops can post adjustments before month close. Also include the raw CSV exports in the ticket.

billing-bot: FYI AWS settlement file posted: s3://aws-settlements/aws-settlement-2026-02.csv (contains reseller fee 10% lines and settlement IDs).

ajay (Eng-Infra): Got it. I'll share a minimal reconciliation table once I finish the exports — will include a line-level diff and recommended adjustments.

maria (Finance): Thanks — let's sync if you find anything that requires cross-team approval.
